cell.display_name: UMBL Mohtat2020 | 5 Ah NMC/graphite research pouch
cell.match_evidence: Original author model is bundled with these five experimental charging files in the same DOI deposit. Cell is fabricated by UMBL, not an identified commercial part. Exact specimen identity is not given.
cell.model_context: Author MPMe model and PyBaMM Mohtat2020 variant; selectable parameter origins
cell.note: Custom laboratory pouch. NMC532 label follows the PyBaMM implementation, not a composition assay in this deposit. Author and PyBaMM graphite OCP offsets, thermal geometry and temperature laws differ. Capacity-axis charge files have measured voltage/temperature but no exported current/time. Source Cover2 rate description conflicts are retained.

coverage.ocp: Two original author OCP expressions plus two PyBaMM variants; graphite x-offset differs (0.007 versus 0.001). Raw half-cell points absent.
coverage.diffusion: Original author D_n=5e-15 and D_p=8e-15 m2/s; PyBaMM same reference values with added Arrhenius dependence.
coverage.kinetics: Original k0_n=1.1e-11 and k0_p=5e-11 with source i0 definition; PyBaMM exchange-current prefactors are rounded/unit-converted and have added temperature dependence.
coverage.full_cell_tests: Five original charging MAT files, 0.1/0.2/0.5/1/2C by code/inventory. Measured voltage and temperature versus capacity; current, timestamps, discharge and C/20 files absent.

pybamm-25-4-2.title: PyBaMM v25.4.2: pinned lithium-ion parameter implementations
pybamm-25-4-2.role: Redistributable software distribution for Prada2013, Chen2020, Marquis2019, Mohtat2020 and NCA_Kim2011. Scientific origin is recorded per function; shared software does not establish shared measurement origin. Prada2013 borrows its OCPs from Afshar2017 and Chen2020. Ecker2015 and Ai2020 modules are also pinned; original and borrowed function origins are recorded separately.
